scope: Analytical logical payload only, not physical residency, tile traffic, power, or GPU performance

glass.limitation: orthographic analytic convex thickness, single-layer screen refraction; no off-screen or multiple-bounce refraction

sand.limitation: stylized elongated grains, not fluid rheology or granular collision simulation

particle.limitation: weighted blended approximation; sorted transparency is a separate non-equivalent fallback

shadowwater.limitation: two fixed orthographic cascade domains, 3x3 PCF; no camera-fitted stabilized CSM, no wave ray tracing

forwardplus.limitation: 2D conservative tile/light circle overlap; not depth-clustered 3D light culling

particle.algorithm: semi-implicit gravity and bounded wall bounce

boids.algorithm: O(N squared) cohesion, alignment, short-range separation; bounded demo size

wave.algorithm: second-order finite difference height equation, periodic boundaries, coefficient .15

depth_storage_note: DEPTH_COMPONENT24 counted as 3 logical bytes; actual alignment/allocation may be larger. These are estimates, never VRAM residency.
